verdict.rationale: Open Finance is an API product with non-interactive token generation from a Partner ID, secret and appKey. A non-billable, unlimited Test Drive sandbox with test personas suits automated runs, and an official GitHub test project generates a client library from the OpenAPI spec. However, nothing documents CI pipelines specifically, and account linking goes through Connect, which may not be fully headless. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation, a fully headless account-linking flow for tests, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use your Partner ID and Secret with the following endpoint whenever you need to generate a new access token
Test Drive is a non-billable, unlimited plan that provides access to all Open Finance API endpoints.
The test project generates an API client library from the API specification like you would do in a real application
we provide you with a set of testing personas. Each persona represents an example of a user who might use your app.
